title: Recording: Waiting For The Sunrise, What A Bastard The World Is, I Want My Love To Rest Tonight by Yoko Ono | 1972
content:
Record Plant, New York City
Producers: John Lennon, Yoko Ono

Yoko Ono recorded three songs for her third album Approximately Infinite Universe on 26 October 1972, with John Lennon co-producing.

‘Waiting For The Sunrise’ was the only new song recorded on this day, and was mixed on 4 November.

‘What A B*****d The World Is’ had been started on 19 October, but was re-recorded from scratch on 24 October. It was recorded a third and final time during this session. Strings were added on 20 November, and the song was mixed in stereo the following day.

The final song of the day was ‘I Want My Love To Rest Tonight’. It was first recorded on 23 October, but remade on this date and mixed on 5 and 11 November. Again, strings were added on 20 November, and the song was finally mixed the next day.
